primitives.name: Source Graph Hardening Foundation
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Expert Partner Signal Playbook StatKing now treats this area as part of the Source Graph + Media Intelligence hardening foundation.
primitives.assumptions: Sources must be rights-gated prior to any processing stage. Scalability is modeled through paginated triage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when rights-gating is bypassed or triage logic fails under 500K+ URL load.

layer2.mapping: The source graph structure maps to a Bayesian belief network where each node represents a rights-gated data source with probabilistic integrity constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Number of gated sources processed per time interval, triage accuracy rate.

primitives.name: Rights-Gated Intelligence Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Sources are rights-gated before display, storage, redistribution, training, or expert-signal conversion.
primitives.assumptions: All data ingestion stages require explicit rights validation. No unauthorized use of content across pipeline stages.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs upon unauthorized access or bypass of rights checks during data handling.

layer2.mapping: Rights gating acts as a kernel function that filters input streams into valid and invalid subspaces in the intelligence space.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of sources passing rights validation, number of unauthorized access attempts.

primitives.name: Paginated Triage Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Candidate scale is modeled for 500,000+ URLs with paginated review and triage.
primitives.assumptions: Scalable triage supports 500K+ URLs using pagination. Each page contains a fixed set of candidates for review.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when pagination limits exceed capacity or triage logic misclassifies candidates.

layer2.mapping: Triage model mirrors a hierarchical decision tree applied over URL sets, where each level corresponds to a pagination window.
layer2.telemetry: Average triage latency per page, classification error rate per batch.
